localAi.asyncHint: Model modes (llm/auto) triage asynchronously: the notification is sent immediately and the verdict is written to the audit log. Use Rules mode if rules must suppress notifications.
localAi.rulesHint: Built-in rules cover errors, status, cost and task name. Custom rules: notifications.triage.rules, e.g. {"field":"cost","operator":"gte","value":1}.
localAi.fallback: When the model does not answer
localAi.hint: An empty model name or a missing Ollama does not block notifications: the fallback handles them. A URL ending with /v1 switches to the OpenAI protocol.
localAi.title: Local assistant (triage)
localAi.wizard.screen1.title: Step 1 of 3 — Choose a model
localAi.wizard.screen1.desc: A local model reads task-completion notifications and helps decide whether to send them. Choose a provider and model.
localAi.wizard.screen1.modelDesc: For example qwen3:4b, llama3.1:8b or gpt-4o-mini.
localAi.wizard.screen1.consequence: If the model does not answer: notifications are still delivered (fallback), and in llm/auto mode triage becomes advisory only.
localAi.wizard.screen2.title: Step 2 of 3 — Preset
localAi.wizard.screen2.desc: Choose a ready-made settings bundle for your situation.
localAi.wizard.screen2.preset.minimal.de: Rules only: fast and reliable, no model. Notifications are not suppressed unless a rule matches.
localAi.wizard.screen2.preset.recommende: Rules plus a local model. If the model does not answer — rules apply. Best balance of speed and accuracy.
localAi.wizard.screen3.title: Step 3 of 3 — Rule order
localAi.wizard.screen3.desc: Review the order in which triage rules will fire, and set the model confidence threshold.
localAi.wizard.screen3.confidenceHint: This is the «threshold for falling back to rules», not a «notification filter». If model confidence is below the threshold, control passes to the rules (or the notification is sent if fallback: notify).
localAi.wizard.screen1.baseUrlHint: For Ollama this is usually http://127.0.0.1:11434. For an OpenAI-compatible API, enter the full base URL, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1.
localAi.wizard.screen1.modelRequired: Enter a model — triage cannot connect without one.
localAi.wizard.screen1.baseUrlRequired: Enter the Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible provider.
